## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 3-fascicle commentary on the *[Wú liàng shòu jīng T0360](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0060)* is by [璟興](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%92%9F%E8%88%88) Kyŏnghŭng — one of the major Silla-period Korean Pure Land scholars after [元曉](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%85%83%E6%9B%89) Wǒnhyo. The work documents the post-Wǒnhyo Silla Pure Land doctrinal tradition in its mature form.

**Abstract**

The bracket adopted here (670 – 700) reflects Kyŏnghŭng's mature Silla period, after Wǒnhyo's death (686).

The Taishō text (T1748) is established on the standard apparatus.
